products.title: Padel Good for the Soul Tech T Shirt - Off White
products.body_html:
Good for the game. Good for the soul.

For the rallies that keep you coming back. The Good for the Soul Tech T Shirt combines lightweight technical performance with an off-white base, orange trims and a bold back graphic. Comfortable on court and easy to wear afterwards.

How the fit works

A regular fit through the chest and bicep gives you room to move through every serve, dink and recovery. Available in XS–4XL. Check the size guide to find your fit. If it isn’t right, we’ll remake it.

Fabric & performance

Made from 100% interlock wicking performance polyester in a cool, smooth knit. The lightweight 145gsm fabric is breathable, moisture-wicking and quick-drying, helping you stay comfortable as the match heats up.

Design & colour story

An off-white base meets orange detailing at the neck and sleeves, with a small chest graphic and a larger Good for the Soul design on the back. A confident look for players who love every minute of the game.

Made to order

Your tee is produced only when you order, helping reduce excess stock. It ships in around 10 days, with a free remake if your size isn’t right.

Care

Machine wash cool.

products.title: The Axis Bundle - Black / Desert Dust
products.body_html:
£155 bought separately. Bundle price £135, save £20.

Two coordinating pieces, one easy choice. The Axis Bundle pairs our Axis mid layer with the Cmax Verde polo in Black / Desert Dust, with an orange zip adding a pop of colour to the mid layer. Wear them together on cooler mornings, then take off the mid layer as the day warms up.

What's included

  • One Axis long-sleeve mid layer in Black / Desert Dust with an orange YKK zip.
  • One Cmax Verde short-sleeve polo in Black / Desert Dust.

Your size, your length

Choose from eight chest sizes, XS to 4XL, and Short, Regular or Long lengths: 24 size and length combinations. Your selected size and length apply to both garments in the bundle.

  • Short: up to 5'7".
  • Regular: 5'7" to 6'.
  • Long: over 6'.

Both garments are regular fit. Short and Long body lengths are 5cm shorter or longer than Regular. Check the size guide before ordering.

Made for your round

  • Four-way stretch for freedom of movement through your swing.
  • Moisture-wicking polyester fabric for comfort on the course.
  • Polygiene® Stay Fresh technology.
  • A stand-up collar and 27cm YKK zip on the mid layer for adjustable coverage.
  • Coordinating colour-block panels and subtle Bunker chest branding.

Made to order

Your mid layer and polo are made when you order and shipped in around 10 days.

What if it doesn't fit? Every garment is made just for you. If it doesn’t fit quite right, we’ll remake it for free, with no extra cost.

products.title: Padel + Planet T Shirt
products.body_html:
No planet B. Built to move.

Padel is quick, reactive and relentless. The Off White Sustain Padel T Shirt is designed to move naturally through every rally, combining a clean athletic fit with lightweight technical performance.

How the fit works

Cut for a clean athletic fit with full freedom of movement. The fabric stretches naturally with the body, so every sprint, swing and recovery feels effortless. A considered size range makes it easy to find your fit, and if it isn’t right, we’ll remake it.

Fabric & performance

Lightweight technical performance fabric keeps you comfortable through long sessions. Breathable construction and moisture-wicking fibres help manage sweat, while the quick-dry finish keeps the tee feeling fresh as the intensity rises.

Design & colour story

Quiet on the front, with a Padel and Planet graphic on the back. The Off White colour keeps the look clean, calm and versatile, while the Sustain name reflects the idea behind the piece: performance and responsibility should move together.

Made to order, made responsibly

No planet B. That’s why every Padel Mentality tee is made to order, with production starting only when you place your order. We make only what players actually want, helping reduce excess stock and unnecessary waste. Your tee ships in around 10 days, with a free remake if your size isn’t right.

Padel is quick, reactive and relentless. The Padel Punk T Shirt keeps the front clean and understated, then brings the attitude through a bold graphic on the back. Lightweight, breathable and built to move, it is made for the court and everything around it.

How the fit works

Cut for a clean athletic fit with full freedom of movement. The fabric stretches naturally with the body, so every sprint, swing and recovery feels effortless. A considered size range makes it easy to find your fit, and if it isn’t right, we’ll remake it.

Fabric & performance

Lightweight technical performance fabric keeps you comfortable through long sessions. Breathable construction and moisture-wicking fibres help manage sweat, while the quick-dry finish keeps the tee feeling fresh as the intensity rises.

Design & colour story

The front keeps things deliberately minimal, creating a clean everyday silhouette. Turn around and the Padel Punk graphic does the talking, bringing a sharper edge to a technically capable court tee.

Made to order, made responsibly

Every Padel Mentality tee is produced only when you order, creating only what players actually want and reducing excess waste. Your tee ships in around 10 days, with a free remake if your size isn’t right.

products.title: Aria Polo - Butter, Blue
products.body_html:
Comfort and Confidence On the Course
Designed for movement and all-day comfort, the Aria golf polo keeps you feeling cool and confident through every round. Lightweight, breathable fabric helps regulate temperature while maintaining a clean, modern silhouette.

Made to Move
Cut in 8 considered sizes, the Aria Polo offers a comfortable fit that moves naturally with your swing. The fabric stretches with the body, allowing full freedom through every shot.

If it’s not right, we’ll remake it.

Made to Order. Produced Responsibly.
Every Aria polo is produced only when you order.

No excess stock. No unnecessary production.

By producing on demand we reduce waste and create only what is needed.

Your polo ships in around 10 days.

Performance Fabric
Lightweight performance fabric with breathable, moisture-wicking properties keeps you comfortable through long rounds and warm conditions on the course. Finished with Polygiene® technology to help control odour and keep the garment feeling fresher for longer. Structured enough to retain its shape across repeated wear.

Butter and Blue Stripe
A simple clean stripe with block off white yoke and contrast collar. Deigned to feel confident on the course and easy to pair with both classic and contemporary golf looks.

The Black Sleeveless Bonded 3 Layer Soft Shell Gilet Vest combines style, comfort, and durability. How it feels to wear
Light and balanced on the body, this polo moves cleanly through your swing without pulling or shifting. It sits properly on the shoulders and chest, stays comfortable through the round, and feels considered rather than standard.

How the fit works

Made to your exact chest size and preferred length for a clean, proportioned fit. Designed to follow your frame without excess fabric or restriction, so it feels natural at address and through impact.

Made to order + delivery
Each CMax Roller Polo is made to order to ensure the fit is right. Your piece ships in around 10 days.

Lightweight, breathable performance fabric with built-in stretch for unrestricted movement. Moisture-wicking, odour-resistant, and structured to hold its shape round after round.

Design & colour story
A deep Navy base with clean stripe detailing through the sleeve trim with pink and light blue detailing. Understated from a distance, precise up close - easy to pair with tailored trousers or relaxed layers across the range.

Quiet reassurance
Designed to fit properly, move naturally, and feel right every time you step onto the course.
